outline: The course of ”The Contemporary Architectural Thinkings” deals with the readings and theories concerning the evolution, transformation and mutation of contemporary architecture. The course covers critical issues relating to historic, cultural and socioeconomic background of architecture. It talks about both the content and context of the formation of contemporary architectural thinkings.
schedule:
week1:
The modernity and modern architecture
week2:
The matrix and philosophy of contemporary architecture
week3:
Contemporary cultural theory1:from Walter Benjamin to Henri Lefebvre
week4:
Contemporary cultural theory2:from Roland Barthes to Jean Baudrillard
week5:
Contemporary cultural theory3:from Lyotard to Foucault
week6:
The other architecture: from Piranesi to Tafuri
week7:
Semiology and the urban: Robert Venturi and sign
week8:
Form and type: Aldo Rossi and collective memory
week9:
Modernity and tradition: from Le Corbusier to Ando
week10:
Mobility and Mutation: from Ghery to Koolhaas
week11:
Phenomenology and morphology: from Steven Holl to Thom Mayne
week12:
Imagination and material: Herzog & de Meuron
week13:
Spaces in the electronic age: Hadid and MVRDV
week14:
Rethink modern architecture: Alvaro siza
week15:
The meaning of architecture: Peter Eisenman
week16:
Rethink architectural thinkings: Kahn, Pei and Stirling
